api/AUTHENTICATION.title: Authentication
api/AUTHENTICATION.description: The AHOY Tokenisation API supports three authentication methods: API Keys for server-to-server communication, JWT Bearer Tokens for session-based access, and SIWE (Sign In With Ethereum) for wallet-based authentication.

api/SDK_REFERENCE.title: TypeScript SDK Reference
api/SDK_REFERENCE.description: The AHOY Tokenisation SDK provides a Stripe-like TypeScript client for the tokenisation platform. Install the umbrella package or individual packages:

ARCHITECTURE.title: AHOY Tokenisation SDK — Architecture Document
ARCHITECTURE.description: A compliance-first, plugin-driven tokenisation platform for issuing, managing, and trading regulated digital assets across any vertical.

architecture/OVERVIEW.title: Architecture Overview
architecture/OVERVIEW.description: The AHOY Tokenisation Platform is a monorepo that provides end-to-end infrastructure for tokenising real-world assets. This document describes the high-level architecture, package structure, server internals, and multi-chain deployment model.

CONCEPTS.title: Core Concepts
CONCEPTS.description: This page explains the fundamental building blocks of the AHOY Tokenisation Platform: packages, assets, tokens, investors, transfers, compliance policies, and the audit trail.

deployment/DOCKER.title: Docker Compose Deployment
deployment/DOCKER.description: Run the full AHOY Tokenisation SDK stack locally or as a hosted sandbox using Docker Compose. The stack includes the API server, PostgreSQL, Redis, and a local Ethereum node (Anvil).

deployment/KUBERNETES.title: Kubernetes / Helm Deployment
deployment/KUBERNETES.description: Deploy the AHOY Tokenisation SDK to production on Kubernetes using Terraform for AWS infrastructure provisioning and Helm for service deployment.

FAQ.title: FAQ
FAQ.description: Common questions about the AHOY Tokenisation Platform.

getting-started/FIRST_PROJECT.title: First Project Tutorial
getting-started/FIRST_PROJECT.description: This tutorial walks you through a complete real estate tokenisation workflow: creating an organisation and project, uploading legal documents, creating an asset, deploying an ERC-3643 security token, onboarding investors with KYC verification, issuing tokens, and distributing dividends.

getting-started/INSTALLATION.title: Installation
getting-started/INSTALLATION.description: This guide walks you through installing the AHOY Tokenisation SDK packages and setting up your development environment.

getting-started/QUICKSTART.title: Quickstart
getting-started/QUICKSTART.description: This guide takes you from zero to a working tokenised asset in under five minutes. You will install the SDK, create an organisation, onboard an investor, create an asset, deploy a token, and execute a transfer.

GLOSSARY.title: Glossary
GLOSSARY.description: A reference of key terms and concepts used throughout the AHOY Tokenisation Platform.

guides/BUILDING_REAL_ESTATE_APP.title: Building a Real Estate App
guides/BUILDING_REAL_ESTATE_APP.description: This tutorial walks you through building a complete real estate tokenisation platform using the AHOY SDK. You will create a React application with property browsing, investor onboarding, investment flows, portfolio management, secondary market trading, and an admin dashboard — following the same architecture as the reference app at apps/real-estate/.

guides/COMPLIANCE.title: Compliance Engine Guide
guides/COMPLIANCE.description: The AHOY compliance engine enforces regulatory rules for every token operation -- transfers, issuances, redemptions, and more. It uses a policy-based architecture with versioned rulesets, deterministic evaluation, and cryptographically signed decision receipts.

guides/REACT_INTEGRATION.title: React Integration Guide
guides/REACT_INTEGRATION.description: This guide covers how to build React applications with the AHOY Tokenisation SDK using @tokenisation/sdk-react hooks and @tokenisation/ui-kit components. By the end, you will understand the provider setup, hook patterns, component library, and how to wire everything together.

guides/REAL_ESTATE.title: Real Estate Tokenisation Guide
guides/REAL_ESTATE.description: This guide walks through the complete workflow for tokenising a real estate property on the AHOY platform, with a focus on UAE/Dubai properties using the Dubai Land Department (DLD) integration and VARA compliance.

guides/WEBHOOKS.title: Webhooks Guide
guides/WEBHOOKS.description: Webhooks deliver real-time event notifications to your application over HTTPS. Instead of polling the API, register an endpoint and the platform pushes events as they happen -- token deployments, transfer completions, KYC status changes, compliance decisions, and more.

PLATFORM-DEVELOPER-GUIDE.title: Platform Developer Guide — Real Estate Reference App
PLATFORM-DEVELOPER-GUIDE.description: Welcome to the Tokenisation SDK. This guide is for you — the platform developer building the reference real estate app. You don't need to understand the SDK internals. You just need to know how to use it.

recipes/AIRLINE_TICKETS.title: Airline Ticket Tokenisation
recipes/AIRLINE_TICKETS.description: Tokenise airline tickets as ERC-721 NFTs with burn-after-use semantics, dynamic metadata for gate and seat changes, anti-scalping transfer controls, and Chainlink Automation for auto-expiry and refunds.

recipes/CAR_RENTALS.title: Car Rental Tokenisation
recipes/CAR_RENTALS.description: Tokenise car rental agreements as ERC-721 NFTs with deposit escrow, vehicle condition tracking, multi-step inspection flow, and Chainlink Automation for overdue and no-show detection.

recipes/CONCERT_TICKETS.title: Concert Ticket Tokenisation
recipes/CONCERT_TICKETS.description: Tokenise concert and live event tickets as ERC-721 NFTs with on-chain anti-scalping price caps, seating tier enforcement, QR-code gate scanning, and Chainlink Automation for post-event expiry.

recipes/HOTEL_RESERVATIONS.title: Hotel Reservation Tokenisation
recipes/HOTEL_RESERVATIONS.description: Tokenise hotel reservations as ERC-721 NFTs with full lifecycle management, room upgrades, stay extensions, automated no-show detection, and on-chain audit trails.

security/SECURITY_AUDIT_CHECKLIST.title: Smart Contract Security Audit Checklist
security/SECURITY_AUDIT_CHECKLIST.description: Pre-deployment security review for all Tokenisation Platform smart contracts.

security/SECURITY_MODEL.title: Security Model
security/SECURITY_MODEL.description: This document describes the security architecture of the AHOY Tokenisation SDK, covering authentication, authorization, smart contract security controls, audit logging, and infrastructure hardening.
